name: Merchant Caravan
description: A traveling merchant caravan passes through, offering rare goods and news from distant lands.
narration: A colorful merchant caravan rolls into {location_name}. The merchants unpack exotic wares and share tales of distant lands.

name: Wolf Pack on the Hunt
description: A hungry wolf pack stalks the roads, threatening travelers and livestock.
narration: Howls pierce the night around {location_name}. A wolf pack hunts the roads, their eyes glinting in the darkness.

name: The Alpha Rises
description: The largest wolf of the pack steps forward, challenging intruders to single combat.
narration: From the shadows, a massive wolf steps forward — the alpha. It locks eyes with you, a silent challenge hanging in the cold air.

name: Traveling Bard
description: A wandering bard arrives, performing songs and spreading news and rumors.
narration: A lute's melody drifts through {location_name}. A traveling bard has arrived, and with them, news from across the realm.

effects.rumor: A dragon has been spotted in the northern peaks.

name: Mysterious Stranger
description: A cloaked figure in the corner of the tavern seems interested in the party's exploits.
narration: In the corner of the tavern, a cloaked stranger watches you. When your eyes meet, they nod subtly and vanish into the crowd.

effects.hint: The stranger left a cryptic map fragment on your table.

name: Village Festival
description: The village is holding a festival tonight — music, food, and competitions!
narration: Lanterns strung between every building cast a warm glow over {location_name}. Tonight is the annual harvest festival — music, dancing, and feasting await.

name: Festival Competition
description: A friendly competition at the festival rewards skill and luck.
narration: The festival organizer announces a competition — archery, wrestling, or the riddling contest. Victory brings glory and a prize.

name: Ash Storm
description: Winds from the Ashfall Wastelands carry a choking cloud of ash across the land.
narration: A grey wall of ash rolls in from the east. The air turns thick and bitter. You must cover your mouth and find shelter.

name: Hermit's Warning
description: A reclusive hermit emerges from the wilderness with a dire warning about ancient ruins.
narration: From the shadows of {location_name}, an old hermit stumbles toward you. 'Turn back,' they rasp. 'The old stones remember... and they are waking.'

effects.hint: The hermut mentioned a hidden chamber beneath the caves.

name: Cave Earthquake
description: The ancient ruins tremble as something deep below shifts.
narration: The ground lurches beneath your feet. Dust and stone rain from the ceiling of {location_name}. The ancient ruins are settling — or something within them is stirring.

name: Starry Omen
description: An unusual celestial alignment catches everyone's eye, sparking prophecies and unease.
narration: The stars wheel into an unnatural alignment above {location_name}. Three blood-red points of light trace a triangle in the sky. The villagers whisper of old prophecies.
